About the Role

Snowflake is seeking an experienced technology transactions attorney to join our world-class legal team as Senior Corporate Counsel 2, Strategic Product Partnerships. This role reports directly to the Director, Product Partnerships and will serve as a critical partner to Snowflake's Business Development, Product, and Strategic Partnerships teams.

You will be at the center of the strategic technology transactions that directly shape Snowflake’s product and go-to-market strategy, handling some of the most consequential and fast-moving deals in the industry. The product partnerships portfolio is broad and structurally varied. A meaningful and growing portion of the portfolio involves AI partnerships — agreements with frontier and alternative AI model providers and hyperscalers. This role will be at the forefront of that expansion. It also includes deep integration partnerships with enterprise software companies — such as zero-copy and bi-directional data integrations; OEM and white-label arrangements in which a partner embeds or resells Snowflake as part of its own offering; and bundling or co-sell arrangements with technology platform partners, including arrangements where Snowflake is sold alongside or on top of third-party infrastructure. These deals frequently involve fee structures, revenue sharing, licensing, and complex IP and data use considerations.

Our ideal candidate is a pragmatic, business-oriented lawyer who excels at complex negotiations, thinks strategically, communicates clearly with senior stakeholders, and is energized by working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This is a hybrid role based in Menlo Park.

What You'll Do

•  Structure, negotiate, and close complex commercial and strategic agreements, including those for AI, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, and other product-related partnerships.

•  Partner closely with Business Development, Product, Engineering, and Strategic Sourcing teams on high-priority technology transactions and AI partnerships, including agreements with frontier AI, open-weight and alternative AI model providers and hyperscalers.

•  Provide sound, practical guidance on legal and business-related issues to senior business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, balancing legal risk with real-world business imperatives.

•  Monitor the overall deal workflow for the product partnerships portfolio; identify bottlenecks and proactively drive resolution.

•  Lead the development and ongoing improvement of contract templates, playbooks, policies, and scalable contracting processes to streamline and simplify the partnerships contracting lifecycle.

•  Collaborate cross-functionally with product, privacy, and security legal, finance, tax, engineering, and compliance teams to appropriately manage risk and support deal execution.

•  Stay current on the rapidly evolving legal and regulatory landscape affecting AI partnerships, cloud agreements, data processing, subprocessors, and related areas — and proactively surface emerging issues to the team before they arrive in a transaction.

•  Build institutional knowledge and share expertise across the team to ensure continuity and resilience in a high-velocity environment.

•  Demonstrate leadership behaviors that elevate the team: help set standards, mentor junior colleagues, run cross-functional forums effectively, and think about objectives — not just execution.

•  Support additional responsibilities of the broader Technology Transactions and Alliances team as required.

What We're Looking For

•  JD from an accredited law school; active bar membership with the ability to practice in California required.

•  7+ years of legal experience as a practicing attorney, including training at a top law firm and meaningful in-house experience at a SaaS or technology company.

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere.
